description: Lets HiveRec send a recruitment agency's emails (through Resend, EU region eu-west-1) from the agency's own domain: an MX record and SPF for bounces on the send. name, and the DKIM key on resend._domainkey. Applied with the host parameter set to the agency's sending subdomain (for example host=mail for bookings@mail.example.co.uk), or with no host when the agency sends from the domain itself. The domain's own MX records, website and mailboxes are not changed.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: the DKIM public key Resend issued for this sending domain, base64 only (the part after p=).
